22808: A math-savvy 17-year-old high school student and a moderator of the interactive computer world OZ along with his close friend Takashi Sakuma. Kenji is less skilled in dealing with people. Kenji is invited by his friend Natsuki Shinohara for Sakae Jinnouchi's 90th birthday.
22809: A spirited 18-year-old high school student and a close friend of Kenji Koiso. She invites Kenji to meet her large extended family for her great-grandmother Sakae Jinnouchi's 90th birthday.
22810: The great-grandmother of Natsuki and indomitable head of the family. Despite her advanced age, she holds the family together. She also has connections in the highest ranks of political and financial circles.
22811: A 13 year old Oz user and one of Natsuki's cousins. On Oz, he is known as King Kazma. He is famous on there for being an excellent fighter in the Martial Arts Championship. He refers to Oz's fighting games as not being a game, but a sport.
22812: A handsome and sardonic 41-year-old computer expert and the "first love" of Natsuki. He is the illegitimate son of Natsuki's grandfather but was adopted by Sakae, whom Wabisuke cares for deeply.
37013: The 6-year-old son of Yorihiko Jinnouchi and Noriko Jinnouchi.
37683: The 40-year-old youngest son of Mansaku Jinnouchi. Katsuhiko is a member of Ueda's fire department and assists in the department's rescue squad.
40931: Antagonist of Summer Wars. AI contracted by the U.S. for "testing". His thirst for knowledge drives him towards hacking OZ after being released by the U.S. Love Machine insatiable thirst for competition is his only weakness.
65577: The 71-year-old daughter of Sakae Jinnouchi and mother of Riichi Jinnouchi and Rika Jinnouchi. She works as a housewife.
65579: The 2-year-old daughter of Kunihiko Jinnouchi and Nana Jinnouchi.
65581: The 32-year-old wife of Kunihiko Jinnouchi and mother of Kana Jinnouchi.
65891: The 41-year-old son of Mariko Jinnouchi. Riichi is a member of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force and is stationed in Camp Ichigaya.
65893: The 42-year-old daughter of Mariko Jinnouchi. She works as an agent of the city's government.
65895: The 70-year-old middle son of Sakae Jinnouchi and father of Tasuke, Naomi, and Kiyomi. Mansuke is an owner of a local fish market. Along with his grandson Kazuma Ikezawa, he trains in Shorinji Kempo.
65897: The 45-year-old son of Mansuke Jinnouchi. Tasuke works as a shopkeeper of an electronics store.
65899: The 42-year-old eldest daughter of Mansuke Jinnouchi who is divorced.
65901: The 21-year-old son of Tasuke Jinnouchi. Shouta is a policeman.
65903: The 39-year-old youngest daughter of Mansuke Jinnouchi and mother of Kazuma Ikezawa. Kiyomi is a care worker based in Nagoya. Throughout the film she is pregnant with Kazuma's sister.
65905: The 68-year-old youngest son of Sakae Jinnouchi and father of Yorihiko, Kunihiko, and Katsuhiko Jinnouchi. Mansaku monitors Sakae's health problems.
65907: The 45-year-old eldest son of Mansaku Jinnouchi. Yorihiko works as an emergency medical technician in Matsumoto's fire department.
65909: The 42-year-old middle son of Mansaku Jinnouchi. Kunihiko works as a fire sergeant in Suwa's fire department.
65911: The 37-year-old wife of Yorihiko Jinnouchi and mother of Shingo and Mao.
65913: The 17-year-old eldest son of Katsuhiko Jinnouchi and Yumi Jinnouchi. Ryohei plays in his local high school's baseball team.
65915: The 7-year-old middle son of Katsuhiko Jinnouchi and Yumi Jinnouchi.
65917: The 4-year-old daughter of Yorihiko Jinnouchi and Noriko Jinnouchi.
